text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A at a gain felt rewarding, but I should base sales on the stock’s outlook and my plan, not on the satisfaction of locking in a profit.","I held through large declines and eventually sold Stocks B and D at steep losses. I should review my risks and position sizes regularly instead of letting reluctance to admit a mistake dictate my choices.","I rarely trade, and short-term movements alone do not justify action. I should make deliberate decisions consistent with my long-term goals rather than reacting to every dip or avoiding review altogether."]}
